manager.charGenDescription: Fetches the genshin-db API (basic data, per-action cooldowns and durations, official icons) and gcsim's GitHub source (60 FPS action frames) from the network each time, generates master data for all characters and updates the app's database.
manager.deleteAllCharsTitleShort: Delete all characters except locked ones
manager.charGenFailedHint: Check your network connection or the GitHub API rate limit (60 per hour). The database was not changed.
manager.weaponGenDescription: Fetches data for all weapons from the genshin-db API each time, then automatically parses and structures base ATK (Lv. 90), substats, passive effects and triggered buffs (duration, cooldown, stat summary) to update the app's database.
manager.deleteAllWeaponsTitleShort: Delete all weapons except locked ones
manager.genFailedHint: Check your network or the API server status. The database was not changed.
manager.weaponReport: Weapon master report: {{total}} total / {{withBuffs}} triggered buffs extracted
manager.artifactGenDescription: Fetches all artifact sets from the genshin-db API each time, then automatically parses and structures 2-/4-Piece effects and 4-Piece triggered buffs (duration, cooldown, stat summary) to update the app's database.
manager.deleteAllArtifactsTitleShort: Delete all artifacts except locked ones
manager.artifactReport: Artifact master report: {{total}} sets / {{withBuffs}} triggered buffs extracted
manager.about1: Supports a complete master database of all 124 characters, combining genshin-db (official values and text) and gcsim (60 FPS action frames).
manager.about2: * Skill/Burst cooldowns, effect durations and 60 FPS-based animation frame times can be freely customized in 0.01 s steps and saved from each character's edit screen in the Characters tab.
manager.exportDescription: Export and download the currently saved database (including your customizations) as a JSON file.
manager.importDescription: Load a saved JSON file to restore and update your customized characters, weapons and artifacts.
manager.importButton: Choose a database file to load
manager.restoreMasterDescription: Restores the database to the official initial set of characters.
manager.clearDbDescription: Completely clears all character, weapon and artifact data.
manager.autoSaved: * Changes to the database are saved automatically in the browser's LocalStorage.
